lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered vertical columns comprising 3 to 5 high-luminance circular clusters, following a repeating grid-like spatial arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that cross the horizontal rows of blobs, forming a distinct matrix of anchor nodes particularly between the gills and dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a dark shadow on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Stochastic distribution of high-luminance blobs within the dorsal fin macro-mask, with higher spatial frequency observed near the anterior base and lower density near the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent diagonal linear feature of high luminance on the mid-lateral flank, potentially representing a healed laceration or scratch; a secondary smaller diagonal mark is visible posterior to the dorsal fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small elongated silhouettes (Echeneidae) are visible trailing the ventral surface and the posterior margin of the pectoral fin.
